title: Fuel Pressure Regulator 1 Control Circuit
shortDescription: Fuel Pressure Regulator 1 Control Circuit: fuel/air metering fault.
fullDescription: Open or fault in fuel pressure regulator 1 control circuit.
safetyImpact: Loss of fuel pressure control can cause stalling and unsafe drivability.

causes.cause: Faulty fuel pressure regulator solenoid
Wiring or connector fault on regulator circuit
Restricted fuel filter or weak fuel pump
PCM driver failure (rare)

symptoms: Rough running or stalling under load

fixSteps.title: Scan for codes
fixSteps.instruction: Connect an OBD-II scan tool, record all codes and freeze frame, then attempt to clear and reproduce.

fixSteps.title: Visual inspection
fixSteps.instruction: Inspect related wiring, connectors, fuses, and components for visible damage, corrosion, or looseness.

fixSteps.title: Test circuit and component
fixSteps.instruction: Use a multimeter or scan tool live data to verify sensor signals, supply voltage, and ground integrity against spec.

fixSteps.title: Replace failed part and verify
fixSteps.instruction: Replace the confirmed faulty component, clear the code, and road test under conditions that triggered the fault.
